name: Sweet & Sour Meatballs with Pineapple & Bell Pepper

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, combine beef, bread crumbs, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
⅜ cup panko bread crumbs
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice onion. Wash, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Cut off skin from pineapple, core, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onion
3 green bell peppers
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ small pineapple

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Form beef mixture into small meatballs and place on a plate.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add meatballs and, turning often, cook until browned on all sides, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
In a medium bowl, prepare sauce by whisking together broth, vinegar, honey, soy sauce, and cornstarch.
instructions.secondary_message:
354 ml (1 ½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
6 tbsp white wine vinegar
3 tbsp honey
1 ½ tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to stove and add more oil. Add onion and bell peppers. Stirring frequently, cook until tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.
Stir in pineapple and cook for about 1 minute.
Pour in sauce and return meatballs to skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine and cook until sauce is thickened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅜ tsp salt
3 pinches crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place in a bowl. Enjoy!
